_comment: Audience classification for every maintained prose surface, consumed by `jig docs check`.
Why this file exists: the checks that make sense for a surface depend on what the
surface is for. A README that names a command jig does not have is a defect. A roadmap
that names a command jig does not have YET is the roadmap doing its job. Without this
distinction the check either produces false alarms on design docs or has to skip the
name checks entirely, and then it catches nothing.
A surface missing from this file is itself an error: a new document that nobody
classified is a document nobody decided the rules for.
user-reference          Current behavior for users. Every skill, command, link, and
counted claim must resolve against what ships today.
maintainer-verification Evidence for a current guarantee. Links must resolve; names may
refer to test functions and historical versions.
maintainer-design       Architecture, roadmap, and rationale. Links must resolve; names
may describe intended or retired state.
